title: This Jellyfish Has 24 Eyes and Can Stop Your Heart in 2 Minutes

scenes.text: This jellyfish has 24 eyes and stops your heart in two minutes.
The Australian box jellyfish. Tentacles trailing ten feet.
Up to 60 of them. One animal carries enough venom to kill 60 adults.
No brain, but 24 eyes in four clusters, and it swims at four knots. Faster than you.
Brush ten feet of tentacle and the venom can stop a heart before you reach the beach.
Over 60 deaths in Australia. And it can see you coming.

description:
The Australian box jellyfish, Chironex fleckeri, has 24 eyes arranged in four clusters and no brain, yet it actively swims and hunts at up to four knots.
Its up-to-60 tentacles can stretch 3 metres and carry enough venom to kill around 60 adults; an untreated sting can cause cardiac arrest in as little as 2 to 5 minutes. It has caused more than 60 recorded deaths in Australia since 1883.
Would you swim in a box jellyfish beach with a stinger net? Comment below.
first_comment: Vinegar poured on the sting stops the unfired stinging cells from going off, which is why Australian beaches keep bottles of it on posts. Did you know that?
